name: Rotterdam School of Management, Erasmus University (RSM)

program.note: International Full-time MBA, January start, 'Full-time | 12 months'. Graduating Class of 2026 had 127 students (employment report).

tuition_total.note: Admissions fee 5,000 on registration + 32,500 (11 Dec 2026) + 32,500 (28 May 2027); includes books and study materials, excludes study-trip travel. Page last update 20 January 2026.

mandatory_fees_total.note: Only extra fixed item listed: immigration fee EUR 254 (non-EU students). The admissions fee is part of the 70,000 tuition.

living_budget_total.note: School states 'about EUR 1,800 a month' for a single student; 21,600 = 12 x 1,800 computed by us (program length 12 months). Higher with partner/children.

examples.name: Fellowship (top-tier)
examples.value: up to three 50% tuition scholarships per year

scholarship.type: merit and diversity scholarships, plus need-based Dean's Assistance Award; granted as tuition fee waiver on final instalment; only one award per student
scholarship.note: 'Scholarship amounts vary'; no average amount or share of class published.

base_salary.note: 'Overall average salary' (base, adjusted with PPP, in USD); report says figures do not reflect salary packages or bonuses. Programme page states 84% found a job within three months (older or different basis).

by_industry.sub: Other* aggregate (all sectors below 6%) - salary row

employment.note: Salaries are PPP-adjusted average base salaries in USD. Industry % sum: the 'Other*' group (27%) is the sum of the small sectors listed separately; the aggregate row is kept only for its salary - do not add it to the sector shares. Geography read from the map image (page 9): North America 8%, Latin America 10%, Asia 2% (text extraction alone is misleading). 'country_change_pct' = '95% changed region' (cohort 99% international). Also: 53% changed function, 79% changed industry, 21% changed all three. Employers = 'Participating and hiring companies MBA26' list (no hire counts); selection shown. Job-function split in the report (p.5) is the incoming class background, not post-MBA jobs, so by_function left empty.

profile.note: Local copy research/sources/rsm-class-profile-2027.pdf. No GMAT published. Graduating Class of 2026: 127 students, 99% international, 30 nationalities, avg age 31, 8 yrs experience, 49% women (employment report).

rankings_cited.note: Search-result extract of find-mba school profile ('52 FT Global MBA 2026'); trade press (wiwi-online) reports '#1 in the Benelux, #52 globally'. FT.com not read.

notes: RSM publishes PPP-adjusted average base salaries; not directly comparable with nominal medians.
